answers.reasoning: 2x-1≤3x+1 gives x≥-2; 3x+1<x+7 gives x<3. The integers -2,-1,0,1,2 total 5.
Expand to x²+2x-8<0=(x+4)(x-2)<0, so -4<x<2. Integers -3,-2,-1,0,1 sum to -5.
M midpoint gives A+C=(4,10); centroid gives A+B+C=(6,9), hence B=(2,-1) and OB=√(4+1)=√5.
A perpendicular tangent has slope 2, so y=2x+b. Distance from origin to it equals √5, hence |b|/√5=√5, |b|=5; positive intercept is 5.
Radius is 3. The fourth-quadrant center is (3,-3). The circle is x²+y²-6x+6y+9=0, so a+b+c=-6+6+9=9.
|x-1|≤6 gives [-5,7]; (x-2)(x-8)≤0 gives [2,8]. Integers 2 through 7 sum to 27.
α+β=-1 and αβ=2, so α²+β²=(α+β)²-2αβ=1-4=-3.
(x-2y)(x+y)=0. If x=2y, the second equation gives 7y²=7, so x+y=±3. If x=-y, it gives y²=7 and x+y=0. Maximum is 3.
For x≤-1 the inequality gives x≥-3; for -1≤x≤2 it holds; for x≥2 it gives x≤4. Thus integers -3 through 4: 8.
The second quadratic is (x-a)(x-4)≤0. Intersecting with x²-x-2>0, whose solution is x<-1 or x>2, yields exactly (2,4] when a=2; the required endpoint 4 and lower boundary 2 force this maximal a.

For the quadratic to never be positive, its maximum must be ≤0 with k+1<0. Discriminant 4-4(k+1)(3k+1)=-4k(3k+4)≤0 gives k≤-4/3 or k≥0; combined with k<-1, integers are k≤-2. The maximum integer is -2.
Separating real and imaginary parts gives a+b=-10 and b-a=-6, hence a=-2,b=-8. Using principal complex square roots, (i√2)(i√8)=-4.
Write the parallel lines as 2x+2y+c=0. Distance from (2,-5) gives |c-6|/√8=√2, so c=2 or 10. Their y-intercepts differ by |(-1)-(-5)|=4.
Let d=b-a>0. Then x₁=a+2d/3, x₂=a+d/5, x₃=a+3d/2, hence x₂<x₁<x₃.
Completing squares gives center (2,1), radius²=a+2. Intersecting x-axis requires a+2≥1, so a≥-1. Avoiding y-axis requires a+2<4, so a<2.

From g₁ roots -3 and 8, its constant term is -24. From g₂ symmetry about x=-5, the true linear coefficient is 10. Thus x²+10x-24=(x+12)(x-2)<0 for -12<x<2; integers -11 through 1 count 13. The opened graphs show these roots/axis.

Reflect A=(0,-5) across x-axis to A′=(0,5). The circle center is (6,-3), radius 1, and A′ to center distance is 10, so minimum reflected path length is 10-1=9. The nearest circle point is (27/5,-11/5); segment A′P meets x-axis at fraction 25/36, giving x_Q=15/4.
The center points (-2,1) and (2,5) are exchanged by the symmetry axis. Their midpoint is (0,3), their connecting slope is 1, so the perpendicular bisector is y=-x+3.

On [1,3], x²-4x+2 has minimum -2 and maximum -1. The equation in t=f(x) is t²+2t-3=0, so t=1 or -3. From the opened graph, y=1 intersects the upward parabola twice and y=-3 touches its vertex once: 3 distinct x values.
Each root satisfies r²=r+1. The power sums S_n obey S_n=S_{n-1}+S_{n-2}, with S_0=2,S_1=1; S_2=3,S_3=4,S_4=7,S_5=11,S_6=18.
Substitution (3,6) gives 0 for every m, so ㄱ is true. Distance from origin is 3/√((2m+1)²+m²), maximized at m=0 as 3, not √5/5; ㄴ false. x-intercept 3/(2m+1) has maximum 3 at m=0; ㄷ true.
Tangency gives nx_n=1, so y_n=√(n²-1)/n. Product from n=2 to 8 equals √[(1/8)(9/2)]=3/4.

The circle has center (0,4), radius 4. For equilateral CAB the chord line is at distance 4cos30°=2√3 from the center. Distance to y=mx-8 is 12/√(m²+1); equating squares gives 144/(m²+1)=12, hence m²=11.
Parallelism gives -a/3=(b-2)/3, so a=2-b. Perpendicularity gives (-a/3)(-b/2)=-1, hence ab=-6. Then a+b=2 and a³+b³=(a+b)³-3ab(a+b)=8+36=44.
With O,A,B consecutive, C=B-A=(12,2). Internal division with BD:DC=2:1 gives D=(B+2C)/3=(11,10/3). The opened figure confirms vertices O-A-B-C in that order.

Let u=a+b-2 and v=a-b. z²=-16 means 2uv=0 and u²-v²=-16; the real solution branch is u=0, v=±4, giving (a,b)=(3,-1) or (-1,3). Condition I with principal complex square roots holds only for (3,-1): √3/√(-1)=-i√3=-√(-3). The translated circle center is (3,-1), radius 5; its chord on x=0 has length 2√(25-3²)=8.

AB has length 2√5 and the line AB is x+2y+5=0, so triangle area at P is |x+2y+5|. On the circle center (1,2), radius 3, this quantity ranges from 10-3√5 to 10+3√5, approximately 3.292 to 16.708. Integer areas are 4 through 16; each level line intersects the circle twice, giving 13×2=26 points.
